name: Try Not To Scream : Coop
detailed_description:
🩸 In Don't Scream Coop, your fear is no longer just virtual.
It follows you in real life.

🎤 Integrated mic, real-time analysis.
Every breath, every word, every scream — the game hears it all.
Every noise exposes you.
Silence is your only defense.

📹 Webcam enabled, facial recognition.
Your face is an open window to your terror.
The game analyzes your expressions, movements, and stress.
The more fear you show, the closer the hunter gets.

🔊 Noise = danger.
Your voice in the mic, a falling object, the click of your flashlight…
Everything draws attention.
And the light?
It lights your path but also reveals your position.

👥 Cooperative mode for 2 to 4 players.
Communicate, coordinate — or stay silent.
Fear is contagious, betrayal deadly.

🧠 Ultra-realistic adaptive AI.
It learns from you, adapts to your behavior.
Your real-life fear becomes your worst enemy.

🚪 Randomly generated levels.
Each game is a unique experience.
You never know where it is. But it always knows where you are.

🔁 Extreme replayability.
Survive once? A lucky break.
Survive twice? Almost impossible.

🫀 No HUD, no map.
Just your breath caught by the mic,
your face watched by the webcam,
and a fear that haunts you.

Don't Scream Coop, the horror game that makes you tremble in real life.
Play if you dare.

short_description: Psychological multiplayer survival horror. You breathe? I hear it. You scream? I see you. Your face betrays your fear, your voice feeds my monsters. In Don’t Scream: Coop, every sound and every glance matters. Frightening. Terrifying. A waking nightmare. Come scream. I’m waiting.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 ou AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti ou AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible DirectX
  • VR Support: Non pris en charge
  • Additional Notes: Un casque audio est fortement recommandé pour une immersion optimale.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains intense psychological horror, sudden loud noises, jump scares, and disturbing imagery. It is not suitable for children or people sensitive to anxiety-inducing content.

There is no sexual content or drug use, but the experience may be stressful or frightening for some players. Player discretion is advised.
